prompts:
Edit the supplied CLEAN TUNER two-screen mockup. Preserve all UI structure, text, numeric readings, instrument selectors, note-zone arc meters, warm frosted champagne silver shell and softly inset ivory faceplate. Replace ONLY the two photorealistic headstock drawings with beautifully art-directed FLAT industrial line illustrations of the SAME recognizable guitar and ukulele headstocks. The user likes actual instrument shapes but dislikes artificial shiny AI-rendered guitars; do not replace instruments with generic vertical string arrays.

Art direction for lower instrument drawings: precise charcoal monoline screen-print on ivory, elegantly proportioned recognizable headstock silhouette, vector-like clarity, minimal warm grey flat fill just a shade darker than the faceplate. NO chrome highlights, NO 3D tuner machines, NO shiny bolts, NO photographic material on the instrument, NO wood grain, NO thick embossed edges, NO drop shadows under instrument. Use a thin clean outline around the headstock and short neck, slightly softened geometric corners. Guitar has a modest curved top with gently tapering sides, ukulele a softly rounded compact top. All peg handles simplified to small flat rounded rectangle outlines on tiny straight stems; tuning posts are tiny single outlined circles. Guitar exactly three pegs per side; ukulele exactly two pegs per side. Fine straight strings between the nut and posts, accurate clear routing and no tangled lines. The drawing should feel like considered instrument iconography on a high-end industrial device, warm and tactile through the surrounding panel, not like a toy render or engineering blueprint with dimensions. Delicate and visually calm but clearly a musical instrument.

Retain six guitar string touch labels with existing correct positions: LEFT SIDE top D₃ string 4, middle A₂ string 5, bottom E₂ string 6. RIGHT SIDE top G₃ string 3, middle B₃ string 2, bottom E₄ string 1. Guitar nut strings left-to-right E₂ A₂ D₃ G₃ B₃ E₄, with each correctly routed to its corresponding post. Only A₂ selected: its tiny post is a solid muted amber circle, its corresponding second-from-left string amber, and a subtle small halo at label A₂. All other string paths grey, no glow. Ukulele labels LEFT top C₄ string 3, bottom G₄ string 4; RIGHT top E₄ string 2, bottom A₄ string 1. Nut strings left-to-right G₄ C₄ E₄ A₄. Only C₄ post and second-from-left string amber. Other labels and lines charcoal. Maintain generous blank space between note labels and instrument silhouette. Whole graphic centered and approximately same footprint as reference, with short neck ending neatly near display bottom.

Also make left upper arc's single orange actual-pitch marker only SLIGHTLY left of apex to represent -8ct. Preserve its three note zones and all text. Do not change the successful warm premium shell. Two screens, front-on polished mockup, exact legible text, no extra explanatory content.

Precise correction to this mockup. Keep EVERYTHING unchanged except the amber guitar string selection in the left screen. Currently the upper-left guitar post labeled 4 D3 incorrectly glows. It must be plain charcoal/ivory, and the line running from that upper-left post to the nut must be grey. The ONLY amber post on the guitar must be the MIDDLE LEFT post next to label 5 A2. The ONLY amber guitar string must run from that middle-left post to the SECOND nut position from viewer left and straight down from there. Remove all orange from the top-left post and its third-from-left string. Leave A2 label halo intact. Right ukulele untouched. No other edits.
review: Recognizable instrument outlines and corrected selected string routing. Pitch marker remains schematic, not a calibrated -8 cent angle.
